chunks: And a group informed me from several of our companions from Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim from his father from Ibn Umair from Saeed ibn Ghazwan from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There will be nine Imams after Husain; the ninth of them is their Qaim.
ai.seo_question: Who is the ninth Imam and who is the Qaim according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* establishes the count of nine Imams succeeding Imam Husain, culminating in the ninth Imam, al-Qaim, who is identified as the Mahdi. It serves as a foundational proof for the doctrine of the Twelve Imams by linking the post-Husain lineage directly to the eschatological figure, reinforcing the continuity of divine authority (Imamah) within the Ahl al-Bayt. The identification of the Qaim as the 'ninth' implies a specific chronological and spiritual succession that is central to Twelver Shia eschatology.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 104 - A group of scholars informed me that Muhammad bin Yaqub narrates from Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim from his father from Ibn Umair from Saeed bin Ghazwan from Abu Basir from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s) that he said:
“After Husain (a.s), there will be nine Imams. The ninth of them is their Qaim.”
